description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewAPI class, a REST API endpoint handler for managing performance reviews within the OrangeHRM system. It includes operations for listing, creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting performance review records, utilizing annotations for OpenAPI documentation. The class interacts with service and DAO layers to perform CRUD operations and applies validation rules specific to performance review management.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing performance reviews, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting reviews. Implements validation and integrates with service/DAO layers. Utilizes OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list performance reviews with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method parameters.

methods.name: getFilterParams
methods.description: Extracts and sets filter parameters from the request for listing reviews.

methods.name: getFilterParamRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules specific to filter parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new performance review.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creation input payload.

methods.name: getCommonValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules used during creation and update of reviews.

methods.name: setReviewParams
methods.description: Assigns request parameters to a PerformanceReview entity instance.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove performance reviews based on IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific performance review by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving a single review.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing performance review.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a review.
